description: This file defines the internal class GrainLocatorResolver responsible for resolving and managing grain locators based on grain types within the Orleans runtime. It provides methods to retrieve appropriate grain locators depending on whether the grain type is a client, uses the default directory, or should be retrieved from cache.

classes.name: GrainLocatorResolver
classes.description: The internal class responsible for resolving grain locators based on grain type conditions.

methods.name: GetGrainLocator
methods.description: Returns the grain locator for a given grain type, creating or retrieving it from cache.

methods.name: GetGrainLocatorInternal
methods.description: Determines the appropriate grain locator internally based on the grain type, such as client, default directory, or cached locator.
